details.summary:
交叉验证结果：
1. RTX 5090: 规格基本确认，价格差异为零售溢价（MSRP $1,999 vs 实际$4,700+）。置信度 0.95→0.90
2. MI300X: 硬件规格确认，LLM推理基准为AMD自报，缺少第三方验证。置信度 0.90→0.85
3. H200: 所有规格和定价被NVIDIA官方确认，TFLOPS差异已解释（sparse vs dense）。置信度 0.90→0.95
4. A100二手: eBay US/UK交叉确认。置信度 0.85→0.85
5. RTX 4090D: 规格被runpod.io确认。置信度 0.90→0.90
6. LLM基准: 关键发现 - A100和RTX 4090的基准数据与独立来源差异10倍，方法论不同导致。H200 ~31,700 tok/s确认。置信度 0.85→0.75
7. 新兴架构: Groq确认~1000 tok/s，Cerebras官方数据低于stage 02峰值。置信度 0.80→0.70
8. 边缘方案: 缺少独立验证。置信度 0.80→0.70

关键风险：LLM推理基准数据因方法论差异存在巨大分歧，必须在阶段03中明确benchmark方法论并统一比较基准。

validation_records.claim: 32GB GDDR7, 512-bit bus, 1792 GB/s bandwidth, 21760 CUDA cores, 575W TDP, $1,999 MSRP
validation_records.notes: Memory specs confirmed. CUDA cores, TDP, and bandwidth discrepancies explained by model variant differences (Newegg aggregates multiple AIB models). Price discrepancy is retail markup, not spec error. MSRP $1,999 is correct; actual purchase price significantly higher.

validation_records.claim: 192GB HBM3, 5.3 TB/s bandwidth, 30-40+ tok/s for 70B FP16
validation_records.notes: Hardware specs (192GB HBM3, 5.3 TB/s) confirmed by AMD. LLM inference benchmark (30-40+ tok/s 70B) is self-reported by AMD; no independent third-party verification found. The computeprices.com source did not include MI300X data. Confidence reduced due to lack of independent benchmark verification.

validation_records.claim: 141GB HBM3e, 4.8 TB/s, 989 TFLOPS FP16 sparse, NVLink 4.0 900GB/s, $28K-40K standalone
validation_records.notes: All key specs confirmed by NVIDIA official page. TFLOPS discrepancy explained (sparse vs dense). Pricing confirmed by thundercompute.com. Cloud rental upper bound slightly higher than stage 02 ($10.85 vs $7.91).
eBay US and UK show consistent pricing. SXM4 modules cheaper individually but require HGX baseboard. PCIe single-GPU systems more expensive but turnkey. Price range $9,500-15,000 for PCIe confirmed.
computeprices.com: 120-140 tok/s; slyd.com: ~1000+ tok/s TensorRT-LLM FP8 optimal batch. 24GB insufficient for 70B. Methodology gap significant.

validation_records.claim: 14,592 CUDA cores (vs 16,384 on 4090), 425W TDP (vs 450W on 4090), 24GB GDDR6X, no NVLink, US export control compliance
validation_records.notes: Specs confirmed by runpod.io article. 4090D is a pruned version of 4090 for US export compliance (<4800 TPP threshold).

validation_records.claim: H200 ~30,000+ tok/s aggregate, MI300X 30-40+ tok/s 70B, H100 dominates 7B, A100 1,200-1,500 tok/s 7B, RTX 4090 ~1,000+ tok/s 7B
validation_records.notes: CRITICAL DISCREPANCY: Stage 02 A100 and RTX 4090 benchmark numbers are significantly inflated compared to computeprices.com. The difference is likely due to: 1) Different model sizes (7B vs 13B-70B), 2) Different quantization (FP8 vs FP16), 3) Different benchmark methodology (prefill vs decode), 4) Different batch sizes. slyd.com uses TensorRT-LLM FP8 with optimal batch sizes - much more aggressive optimization. computeprices.com appears to use more realistic real-world conditions. H200 ~31,700 tok/s (slyd.com) confirms stage 02 ~30,000+ aggregate.

validation_records.claim: Groq LPU: 1000 tok/s per user, 294-750 tok/s 70B, 500-1000+ tok/s 8B
validation_records.notes: groq.com confirms 1000 tok/s per user. AnandTech review confirms LPU architecture claims.

validation_records.claim: Groq: 294-750 tok/s 70B, 500-1000+ tok/s 8B; Cerebras: 1800-3000 tok/s; SambaNova: 300-3000+ tok/s
validation_records.notes: Cerebras official page: up to 750 tok/s for GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast. AnandTech review confirms B100 WSE-2 architecture. Stage 02 claimed 1800-3000 tok/s which may be peak benchmarks from different model sizes.

validation_records.claim: Jetson Orin Nano 8GB: 10-28 tok/s for 1B-3B models; Apple M4 Pro/Max: 35-70+ tok/s for 14B-70B
validation_records.notes: Edge LLM benchmark data lacks independent verification. navyaai.com is a single small blog. Apple M4 Pro/Max unified memory architecture makes it well-suited for LLM inference, but specific benchmark numbers are unverified.

validation_records.claim: Apple M4 Pro/Max: 35-70+ tok/s for 14B-70B via unified memory architecture
validation_records.notes: M4 Pro/Max specs confirmed by AnandTech. LLM inference benchmarks speculative based on unified memory architecture advantage. No independent LLM benchmark found.

critical_risks: LLM推理基准方法论差异巨大(10-70x)，必须在03阶段统一方法论
新兴架构和边缘方案数据置信度较低
